notes.title: Jigsaw Puzzles: Master Artists of Old enters Free-to-Play!
notes.content:
Greetings my puzzle friends,

Jigsaw Puzzles: Master Artists of Old will be entering Free-to-Play!
To all those who purchased and played the game, thank you so much for the support and for enjoying this little Jigsaw Puzzle game and the beautiful artworks of our past. You will ever be appreciated.

I plan on no longer working on development and so I'm just allowing it all to be freely available.

Apologies for any wishes that the game would receive more updates and improvements. Perhaps in the future, I may take it up again, but do not trust to hope. It is a most tiny sliver of a chance.

All the best to you all.
Pax Christi. +JMJ+

notes.title: Saving and Puzzle Completion Update! + More Added Puzzles!
notes.content:
[h2]You may now "Save and Quit" to keep the progress of your current puzzle and continue playing later! [/h2]
Perfect for the more difficult puzzles that can take a bit of time! If you're just too good, feel free to [i]"Quit without saving"[/i]!

[h2]The puzzles you complete now get indicated by an "[b]E[/b]", "[b]M[/b]", and/or "[b]H[/b]"![/h2]
Depending on which difficulties you have completed them on, a little indicator will appear at the [b]top-left[/b] of your puzzles. [b]E[/b], [b]M[/b], [b]H[/b], referring to [b]Easy[/b], [b]Medium[/b], and [b]Hard [/b]respectively.

[h2]A large number of puzzles have been added along with these updates[/h2]
We have hit a grand total of [b]239 jigsaw puzzles[/b] now! I hope you enjoy these beautiful artworks as I do! Happy puzzling!
